summary: All 94 claims trace to the page and roles/priorities match the red boxes; probable/possible labels match likely/consider wording. Main gap: "x-ray unavailable" is not representable, so recent neck injury without an available x-ray and without neuro symptoms will not trigger Urgent, and the injury branch is otherwise redundant. Minor imprecision: carpal tunnel drops relieved-by-shaking; elbow flexion/extension and "uncomfortable" movement are generalised. The non-urgent neck pain approach (risk-factor list to x-ray/refer; analgesia) is not encoded.
